scientific_integrity: A rational first-event recurrence and exact coefficient-induction proof are provided. A separate vertex-mask recurrence checks finite cases; no finite enumeration substitutes for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-ring large-rate expansion to third order; no uniform-in-ring remainder, no finite-time law, no all-rate monotonicity or independent priority certification. Earlier unindexed explicit computations remain possible.
title: Third-order strong-bias adsorption response on alternating cycles
